name: AI Enterprise Engineer
target: Forward-deployed and enterprise AI roles: deployment, integration, customers.

content.summary: Applied AI engineer delivering production GenAI systems inside government at national scale — architecture through deployment, with governance and cost engineering treated as first-class requirements. Shipped a multilingual assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in, sole-engineered a drafting platform piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session, and authored the AI scope and feasibility assessment for the Prime Minister Internship Scheme.

experience.employer: EY (deployed to National e-Governance Division, MeitY)
experience.context: Lead a team of 4 interns and 1 analyst. AI engineering and advisory for Government of India digital platforms — Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Sports Authority of India, and Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Architected and shipped a citizen-facing multilingual RAG assistant on Azure — 206 documents / 11,611 chunks, 12 languages (9 voice-enabled) via Bhashini with Sarvam fallback — designed for 10,000 daily users with strict grounding, refusal templates and monetary redaction at ingestion and output.

Reduced production run-rate ~60% (₹9.4L → ₹3.5L per month, ~₹1.35 per query) by re-architecting the stack, while raising judged answer correctness to 3.9 / 4 on a 213-case eval bank measured across 28 archived evaluation runs.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AI drafting platform (95 endpoints, 34 tables, 33 migrations) piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session, grounding official replies in 702 prior tabled Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers with per-sentence citations.

Built the full Bedrock retrieval pipeline — semantic cache, LLM planner, reranking, recency blending with per-claim volatility half-lives — plus a text-to-SQL layer hardened by sqlglot AST validation, statement timeouts and read-only transactions; two eval harnesses gate releases.

blocks.title: PMIS — AI scoping, Prime Minister Internship Scheme · Ministry of Corporate Affairs

bullets.text: Authored the 12,000-word AI Scope Document and 14-page Feasibility Assessment — 19 use cases consolidated into 8 features on 6 shared building blocks across a 144 person-month programme, phased behind five data gates.

experience.context: Oracle Cloud Partner — 20+ enterprise clients including Aditya Birla Group, Adani, and Acko.

bullets.text: Architected a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AWS EC2 + Nginx, cutting deploy time 80% (15 min to under 3) with zero-downtime rolling releases, saving ~2 hrs of manual effort per cycle.

Engineered a real-time inventory backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) automating 3 reconciliation workflows, eliminating ~4 hrs/day of ops overhead, and consolidating 15+ scattered permission checks into one JWT RBAC middleware layer.

experience.context: Ed-tech platform delivering courses in web development, ML, and embedded systems to students across India.

bullets.text: Reduced frontend render latency by ~28% on a live multi-user ML platform (React DevTools Profiler) via React.memo and lazy loading — zero backend changes, zero regressions.
Built vendor-agnostic normalisation adapters over third-party ML APIs, fully decoupling business logic from vendor schemas and making future API swaps non-breaking.
